svg.title: Model vs handbook yield strength for seven classic alloys
svg.desc: Grouped bars, yield strength in MPa, raw model / calibrated / handbook. 5083 / 5182 (Al-5Mg): 73, 143, 130 to 145; 6061 (Al-1Mg-0.6Si): 15, 55, 55; 7075 (Al-Zn-Mg-Cu): 44, 99, 103; Cartridge brass (Cu-30Zn): 164, 117, 75 to 110; Tin bronze (Cu-12Sn): 964, 172, 150 to 190; Aluminium bronze (Cu-7Al): 263, 188, 210 to 230; Silicon bronze (Cu-3Si-1Mn): 42, 105, 145. Tin bronze's raw value, 964, is off the 0 to 300 scale.
